subject: Recap: discovery + propose time-boxed tech walk / loop in security & procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Recap: discovery + propose time-boxed tech walk / loop in security & procurement

Thanks Liam — great conversation today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum:

• Key takeaways from discovery:
  - Primary use: inference for realtime multi-tenant customer-facing features (heavy tail on 1024 tokens)
  - Success metrics: p99 latency < 250ms, predictable unit cost under target, audit logs for data access
  - Constraints: SSO + strict data residency for EU workloads in the future

• Proposed next steps (pick one slot for a time-boxed tech walk):
  - Option A: Tue, Nov 9 — 10:00–10:45 PT (45 min, technical deep-dive + integration checklist)
  - Option B: Wed, Nov 10 — 09:00–09:45 PT (45 min)

Agenda for the 45-min session: 1) architecture/SSO requirements, 2) perf/cost targets and expected QPS, 3) integration checklist and pilot plan.

Separately, would like to schedule a 30-min security touchpoint with your security lead prior to the deep-dive (to cover SOC2, data handling, encryption/KMS). And loop in procurement to align on PO timing — Sara, can you join that thread?

I attached a one-pager and a draft MVP scope to make scheduling easier. If you can confirm preferred slot and the right security + platform contacts, I’ll send calendar invites and an agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-onepager.pdf, mvp-scope.xlsx

From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@acme-cloud.com>

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery + propose time-boxed tech walk / loop in security & procurement

Marissa — thanks for the concise recap. Wed Nov 10 at 09:00 PT works best for our team. Please go ahead and lock that in.

A couple of notes before the tech walk:
• Please include our platform lead, Alex Kim (alex.kim@acme-cloud.com), so we can discuss SSO, network egress, and potential pilot infra.
• We will want to review SOC2 evidence and any data-residency options (EU) in the security touchpoint. Can you share the relevant docs ahead of time?
• For procurement: Sara Nguyen (sara.nguyen@acme-cloud.com) will be the primary contact — looping her into the calendar invite is helpful.

If you can also provide an agenda with timeboxes (e.g., 15 min architecture, 20 min demo/config, 10 min next steps), that would be ideal.

Liam
Liam O'Neal
Head of Platform Engineering
Acme Cloud

Date: 2026-11-08T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Confirming Wed 11/10 09:00 PT — agenda + prep notes

Thanks Liam — locking in Wed, Nov 10, 09:00–09:45 PT. Adding Alex and Sara to coordinate platform/security/procurement.

Draft agenda (time-boxed):
  09:00–09:15 — Architecture & SSO (Alex lead)
  09:15–09:35 — Integration checklist / pilot scope (Marissa + Sean)
  09:35–09:45 — Open questions & next steps (procurement / timelines)

Prep notes / asks:
• Liam / Alex — can you share SSO type (SAML/OIDC), expected identity provider, and any IP allowlist constraints before the call?
• Alex — any cost/QPS expectations that should shape the demo? Rough numbers are fine.
• Sara — can you confirm procurement timeline (how long from SOW to PO) and any standard terms we should be aware of?

Attachments: redwood-onepager.pdf (short value prop), mvp-scope.xlsx (draft pilot checklist). Also linking the HubSpot deal for visibility: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-472

Sean / Priyom — please come prepared with the integration checklist and a short list of questions for platform/security. Priyom — would you be OK to own the security touchpoint follow-up (30 min) after this call?

I'll send the calendar invite and include a short agenda + meeting notes doc.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-09T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Confirming Wed 11/10 09:00 PT — agenda + prep notes

Thanks — Sara here from procurement. I’m available for the Wed 11/10 session and appreciate the agenda. A few procurement notes: 

• Timeline: procurement typically needs the SOW + pricing to issue a PO. We target ~30 days from receipt of final SOW but can sometimes expedite for priority pilots.
• Required docs: vendor W-9, signed MOA/NDA (if applicable), and invoice remit details. Please send W-9 and standard T&Cs in advance so we can start routing internally.
• Payment terms: our standard is Net 60; if Redwood needs shorter terms, let me know and I will flag with finance.

I will share a short procurement intake template after this email — it will ask for the SOW owner, billing contact, and expected pilot value. Happy to join the security touchpoint if timelines require.

Thanks,
Sara Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Cloud
